news.headline: Cloudflare (NET) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
news.summary: Shares of cloud security and performance company Cloudflare (NYSE:NET) jumped 6.8% in the afternoon session after falling Treasury yields eased pressure on software stocks as signs of cooler U.S.–China tensions lifted risk appetite.

news.headline: Fastly Soars 14% on AI Firewall Launch; Cloudflare Climbs 7%, Datadog Rises 5%
news.summary: Fastly launched new AI traffic controls this morning and the whole edge security category moved with it, including rivals that announced nothing at all. The question buyers are not asking loudly enough is whether availability and adoption are the same thing.

news.headline: Is It Worth Investing in Cloudflare (NET) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
news.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Cloudflare (NET) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

news.headline: Cloudflare (NET) Stock Looks Rich After Its Huge Three Year Run

news.headline: CrowdStrike, HubSpot, Intuit, Cloudflare, and Okta Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
